title: Client education library
introduction: General educational material for existing CaboHealth clients. It is not a diagnosis, treatment plan, or emergency service.

sections.title: Healthy-aging foundations
sections.summary: Use these general ideas to support a conversation with a qualified health professional.
items: Keep a regular routine for sleep, meals, movement, and recovery when practical.
Write down questions before an appointment so important topics are easier to remember.
Seek professional guidance before making a significant change to health routines.

sections.title: Using educational resources
sections.summary: A short checklist for reading general wellness information with appropriate context.
items: Check the publication date and the organization responsible for the material.
Separate general education from advice intended for one individual.
Contact local emergency services for urgent or emergency concerns.
